GENERATION_RATIONALE: This taxonomy is designed for consistent high-volume coding of PAN readmissions follow-up notes by separating (1) call disposition, (2) care coordination, (3) medication issues, (4) post-operative wound/device concerns, (5) clinical symptoms/red flags, (6) post-op pain and functional recovery, (7) patient education/self-management, and (8) access/social/financial barriers. Themes group operationally similar issues, while subthemes are written to be decisive and largely mutually exclusive; routing notes specify precedence where overlap is common (e.g., symptom vs incision pain, medication access vs insurance/billing, diet confusion vs diet access). The set totals 8 categories, 18 themes, and 56 unique subthemes, matching the requested scale and reflecting recurring patterns evidenced in the sample without relying on one-off cases.
REVIEW_NOTES: First production taxonomy, approved with config haiku_enum_v1.
